correctness.rationale: The explicit 2-step Lie group has a preserved uniform integer lattice and arm permutation action. Its Chevalley–Eilenberg differential is a wedge with a degree-zero nilpotent derivation E. The commuting sl2 triple makes ker E the sum of weight-zero/one character components, uniformly in every exterior degree. Cycle decomposition computes the full graded exterior trace. The graded-super-symmetric invariant series gives the rational quotient polynomial by exact invariant averaging. A standalone independent implementation checked every permutation for n=1,2,3,4 and all 304 graded traces over F_1009. The modular checks support but do not substitute for the characteristic-zero proof.
